title: platform-objects: the sys_user page's Security tab shows the viewer's own "your account" sections, empty, on every other user's record
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2207, the maintainer's browser round on ObjectStack 18.0.0 (「hotcrm 升级到 objectstack 18.0 然后重新安排一轮浏览器测试」). Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-03** of track 2 (the Setup pass as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01BkRPwuAufrFwoEEfuigDm9`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `16c28664` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0 (framework `06cab4849`, console objectui `616df6598b42`), in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-v18-setup-pass` at `4d7cc467d` ([`REPORT.md`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md)), which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Setup → Users → QA Plain → **Security** tab (`/sys_user/record/<id>`).
- **Expected:** a tab on another user's record describes that user, or offers admin actions on them.
- **Actual:**
  - Four headed sections with no controls: "Password & Sign-in — Change your password or the email address associated with this account", "Two-Factor Authentication", "Email Verification", and "Danger Zone — Permanent. Once deleted, your account cannot be recovered."
  - The text addresses "you" and "your account" while the admin is looking at QA Plain.
- **Evidence:** [`07-F03-users-security-tab-self-service-on-other-user.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/07-F03-users-security-tab-self-service-on-other-user.png).
- **Reach:** every admin opening a user record.

## Seat review (source at 18.0.0, `06cab4849`)

- The page is `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`, declared for "admins browsing user records from Setup" (`:9`).
- Its Security tab (`:362-504`) is self-service metadata: `element:text` headings and captions with no visibility condition (for example `:388`, `:488`), plus `record:quick_actions`.
- Every action those blocks name is gated to the viewer's own record (`record.id == ctx.user.id`): `change_my_password` (`sys-user.object.ts:504`), `change_my_email` (`:523`), resend verification (`:540`), `delete_my_account` (`:556`), the 2FA actions (`:593`, `:619`, `:637`).
- On another user's record every action is withheld and `record:quick_actions` draws nothing (objectui#12995, in the pin). Only the "your account" headings remain.
- Not plugin-auth (the tester's guess). Unchanged on `main`.
- Not verified, and not this card: the tab strip runs past 1440 px (API Keys and Preferences off-screen).

## Dedupe

Method: every objectstack-ai/objectstack issue title (every state, #1–#24932) and every objectstack-ai/objectui issue title (#7–#13268), listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint (refreshed with `since=2026-10-19`) and matched case-insensitively. The search API is refused for this session.
- Related, closed: objectstack#24277 (a platform-default Settings tab; cites this Security tab as precedent, not this defect); objectui#12995 (why the sections are empty rather than missing).
- **New.**
